summary: Updated planner worker selection to honor goal.enabledWorkers across planning and revision. In src/goal/cli-planner.ts, added enabledWorkers params, resolved ordered worker attempts via resolveEnabledWorkers, preserved claude->codex fallback when both enabled, switched to immediate codex execution when codex-only, and now throw explicit fallback-disabled errors on Anthropic degradation when claude_code-only. Degraded-plan backend rewrite now only rewrites to codex when codex is enabled. Threaded enabledWorkers from config through all planner/revision call sites in src/commands/goal.ts, src/commands/goal-resume.ts, src/telegram/goal-commands.ts, and src/goal/plan-autocheck.ts. Expanded src/goal/cli-planner.test.ts with codex-only and claude-only planning/revision coverage plus explicit both-enabled ordering checks. Verification run: pnpm build (pass), pnpm vitest run src/goal/ (pass), pnpm lint (pass), and runtime CLI path exercise via node scripts/run-node.mjs goal ... --scout-timeout 0.001 (planner path executed and returned timeout JSON as expected).
